Use the provided Riven's Broken Sword reference for the weapon.

Use the provided MOUNTAIN ROAD TO BURNING SETTLEMENT reference

Use the provided BURNING SETTLEMENT reference
for the destination.

Riven is in her Two Years Later appearance.

She carries only the HANDLE-SIDE REMAINING HALF
of her Broken Sword.

The missing upper half is completely gone.

The remaining weapon is still large and broad,
ending in a rough fractured edge with no pointed tip.

The Broken Sword remains dormant.

No rune glow.
No magical energy.

16:9 cinematic live-action dark fantasy.

Grounded photorealistic realism.

Natural human movement.

Realistic running speed, body weight, and momentum.

Natural hair and cloth movement.

Dynamic but controlled cinematic camera movement.

Dusk mountain atmosphere gradually transitioning
into stronger orange firelight near the settlement.

Natural footsteps, breathing, wind, fire,
distant shouting, and environmental sound.

English dialogue.

Natural lip sync.

No subtitles.

No background music.

No combat.

Keep the geography extremely simple and visually readable.

Use only THREE major cinematic shots.


=== IMPORTANT SPATIAL RULE ===

There are only TWO movement directions in this sequence.

RIVEN moves TOWARD the burning settlement.

EVERY CIVILIAN AND SOLDIER moves AWAY FROM the burning settlement.

The burning settlement is the source
from which the civilians and soldiers are escaping.

They come OUT OF the settlement.

They run down the road toward Riven.

They pass Riven.

They continue away from the settlement.

They NEVER turn around.

They NEVER follow Riven.

They NEVER run toward the fire.

Riven is the ONLY person moving toward
and eventually entering the burning settlement.


=== VIDEO SUMMARY ===

Riven is heading toward a distant burning settlement.

Begin immediately very close to her running feet.

Riven suddenly accelerates into a powerful full-speed sprint
along the mountain road.

Keep the travel section short and energetic.

A foreground tree or rock passes completely across the lens,
creating a natural hidden travel transition.

After the transition,
Riven is much closer to the burning settlement.

People begin emerging FROM the burning settlement ahead.

They are fleeing the fire.

They run from the background toward Riven,
pass her,
and continue away behind her.

Soldiers are retreating with them.

Riven slows down.

She asks one retreating soldier what happened.

He only tells her to run
and continues escaping.

Everyone else leaves.

Riven turns toward the burning settlement.

She walks in the opposite direction from the crowd:

alone toward the fire.


=== SHOT 1 — FULL-SPEED RUN ===

OPEN IMMEDIATELY on an extremely low close tracking shot
beside Riven's boots.

Do not begin with a wide establishing shot.

Do not show Riven standing still.

Do not show the cabin.

Do not recreate an earlier wide composition.

Riven is already moving quickly
along a dry rugged mountain trail.

For the first brief moment,
the camera tracks close beside her boots.

Then Riven pushes harder.

She BREAKS INTO A FULL-POWER SPRINT.

Her stride becomes longer.

Her pace becomes much faster.

Her body naturally leans forward.

Her boots strike the dry dirt trail with force.

Small stones and loose dust kick backward beneath her steps.

The camera rapidly accelerates with her.

Gradually raise the camera
into a close three-quarter tracking view.

Riven is now sprinting at maximum speed.

Her arms drive naturally with each stride.

Her breathing becomes stronger.

Her pale-blonde hair moves rapidly behind her.

Her clothing reacts naturally to her speed.

The Broken Sword remains securely carried on her body.

She does not hold it while running.

It remains completely dormant.


Continue tracking Riven as she races
along the mountain road.

Use the MOUNTAIN ROAD TO BURNING SETTLEMENT reference
for the surrounding geography:

dry mountain trail,

dark pine forest,

rocky slopes,

steep mountain terrain,

and the distant direction of the burning settlement.

Keep the camera relatively close to Riven.

Do not stop for a static landscape shot.

Trees and rocks move rapidly through the background,
creating a strong sensation of speed.

Riven keeps sprinting.

She is covering a significant distance,
but do not show the entire journey in real time.


Eventually Riven races past
a large foreground tree trunk or dark rock
very close to the camera.

The foreground object sweeps completely across the lens.

For a moment,
the entire frame is naturally obscured.

Use this as a hidden TRAVEL WIPE.

Time and distance pass during the obstruction.


=== SHOT 2 — ESCAPING FROM THE FIRE ===

EMERGE DIRECTLY FROM THE TRAVEL WIPE.

Maintain Riven's forward running momentum.

Riven is still moving toward the same destination,
but she is now much closer to the burning settlement.

This is clearly a later point in her journey.

The environment has changed naturally.

The forest is thinner.

Smoke is heavier.

Ash drifts through the air.

Orange firelight flickers across the road.

The sound of burning structures is much louder.


The BURNING SETTLEMENT is now located
AHEAD OF RIVEN,
at the far end of the road.

Keep this geography consistent.

BEHIND RIVEN:

the mountain road she came from.

AHEAD OF RIVEN:

the burning settlement.

Riven continues moving FORWARD
toward the burning settlement.


Through the smoke ahead,
a frightened civilian appears.

The civilian begins near the burning settlement
in the BACKGROUND.

The burning buildings are physically BEHIND this civilian.

The civilian is ESCAPING FROM THE FIRE.

The civilian runs:

FROM THE BURNING SETTLEMENT

DOWN THE ROAD

TOWARD RIVEN

PAST RIVEN

TOWARD THE CAMERA

and then continues AWAY FROM THE FIRE.


Riven and the civilian move
in completely opposite directions.


Then another civilian emerges FROM the settlement.

Then several more.

Every civilian follows exactly the same direction:

BURNING SETTLEMENT
→ RIVEN
→ CAMERA
→ AWAY FROM THE SETTLEMENT.


Nobody runs toward the fire.

Nobody turns around.

Nobody follows Riven.


Several soldiers also emerge
FROM the burning settlement.

They are retreating.

They follow exactly the same movement
as the civilians.

The burning settlement remains behind them.

They run from the fire,
toward Riven,
past Riven,
and continue away.


Riven begins slowing from her sprint
as more people rush toward her.

Keep the burning settlement visible
in the background behind the fleeing crowd.

The geography should now be unmistakable:

THE CROWD IS COMING OUT.

RIVEN IS GOING IN.


Riven slows almost to a stop.

One retreating soldier comes directly
FROM the settlement.

He approaches Riven while running away from the fire.

Riven turns toward him and asks:

"What happened?"

The soldier barely slows.

The burning settlement remains physically behind him.

He urgently answers:

"Just run!"

He immediately continues forward.

He runs PAST RIVEN.

Then PAST THE CAMERA.

He continues down the mountain road,
farther and farther away from the burning settlement.

Riven does not follow him.

She watches him disappear with the other fleeing people.


=== SHOT 3 — AGAINST THE FLOW ===

Riven remains still for a brief moment.

Keep the burning settlement ahead of her.

Civilians and soldiers continue emerging FROM the settlement
and running away from it.

They approach Riven from ahead.

They pass on both sides of her.

Then they continue behind her
toward the mountain road.

Nobody turns around.

Nobody enters the settlement.

Nobody follows Riven.


Riven looks at the fleeing people.

Then she slowly turns her attention
toward the burning settlement ahead.

Hold briefly on her restrained expression.

She does not know what is inside.

She does not draw the Broken Sword.

She does not prepare for combat.


Then Riven makes her decision.

She begins walking TOWARD the burning settlement.


Position the camera in front of Riven,
on the settlement side of the road.

The camera faces Riven
and tracks backward as she advances.

This keeps Riven's face visible
while she moves deeper toward the fire.


Maintain one extremely clear visual contrast:

RIVEN moves INTO the settlement.

EVERYONE ELSE moves OUT OF the settlement.


Fleeing civilians and soldiers come from ahead.

They approach Riven.

They pass her on both sides.

Then they continue behind her,
away from the fire.


Riven is the ONLY person
moving in the opposite direction.


As Riven continues forward,
the number of fleeing people gradually decreases.

The crowd becomes thinner.

The last few civilians pass her.

Then the last retreating soldiers pass her.

Nobody remains ahead except Riven.


Orange firelight becomes stronger across her face and clothing.

Smoke becomes thicker.

The burning buildings become closer.

Riven continues walking deeper
toward the smoke-filled settlement.

She is now almost completely alone.


Do not reveal the mysterious figure.

Do not reveal strange black markings.

Do not show a flashback.

Do not begin combat.

Do not draw the Broken Sword.


Riven continues alone
into the burning settlement.

Smoke gradually surrounds the road ahead.

CUT.


=== END STATE ===

Riven has reached the burning settlement.

All civilians and soldiers are escaping FROM it.

They move away from the fire
and back down the mountain road.

Riven is the only person moving in the opposite direction.

She enters the settlement alone.

She still carries only the remaining handle-side half
of her Broken Sword.

The Broken Sword remains dormant.

Riven has not yet discovered
what caused the destruction.

CUT.、16:9
